title: 50 Days, alot of Opus 5.5 and alot of confussion as first time Dev
author: Educational-Smoke-88
selftext:
I would appreciate any feedback!  
So i started this Project 50 days ago and I am pretty happy with the Progress I added alot of different content in the last 30 days. 



Basically my game is about: Cleaning Service in a town where the trash came to life in a Comic Style Look. You fight it, clean the apartment, recycle the trash, buy new yards/machinery/cars and sell it. I am pretty confused on many concepts like GameFeel and Juice. As i just dont get how to make it feel better, also is it nomal that i cant judge the feel anymore because ive played it and seen it so often? 

You can also check out my yt page, I use it for getting reach while setting up my steam page, I would also appreciate any feedback there!! [https://www.youtube.com/@NeedToCleanGame](https://www.youtube.com/@NeedToCleanGame)

comments.body: that door engineering has me puzzled

replies.body: it opens in a mysterious way at 0:20

replies.author: Educational-Smoke-88
replies.body: Oh youre right. In-game it works correctly. This was just an old shot, I told claude to make this scene and open the door. I guess thats how it solved it?

comments.author: cheyumaama
comments.body: This looks like a cool idea but I'd personally improve the graphics

replies.author: Educational-Smoke-88
replies.body: How would You do that? I had so many iterations of trying to Change the graphics that I am kinda tired of it

replies.author: cheyumaama
replies.body: Just tell it "I need you to make my game look like AAA quality. Don't change the art style, but make it look super high quality visually and graphics wise. Let me know whatever you need to make this happen and do not mark the job as complete until you've personally reviewed it frame by frame and passed it's quality check."

replies.author: Educational-Smoke-88
replies.body: Haha will use that prompt! Is it okay if I Share the results with you in this comment?

replies.author: cheyumaama
replies.body: Bro, of course! I want to see what it says and then how long it will keep working for
